title_ar: قناة فور شباب تستضيف الشيخ الددو للتضامن مع إخواننا في القدس
title_en: The 4Shbab Channel Hosts Sheikh al-Dedew in Solidarity with Our Brothers in Jerusalem
body_ar:
في إطار حملة الريح المرسلة للتضامن مع إخواننا في القدس التي ترعاها لجنة الأعمال الخيرية من دولة البحرين استضافت قناة فور شباب فضيلة الشيخ العلامة محمد الحسن ولد الددو وفضيلة الشيخ رائد صلاح شيخ الأقصى.

وقد بثت قناة فور شباب هذا اللقاء مساء اليوم الأربعاء 15 رمضان 1434هـ الموافق 24 يونيو 2013م

واستعرض الشيخ الددو خلال هذا البرنامج قضية القدس في المسجد الأقصى وتاريخها الإسلامي العريق، متحدثا عن الأصول التاريخية لمدينة القدس (إيليا) والمسجد الأقصى مستعرضا في ذلك حديث رحلة الإسراء والمعراج لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وصعوده إلى السماء.

ودعا الشيخ الددو إلى ضرورة اغتنام هذه الفرصة في دعم هذا المشروع الخيري لقضية القدس والمسجد الأقصى بكل الجهود، وأفتى بأن مسؤولية القدس على عواتق جميع المسلمين سواء فيها القاصي والداني، ويمكن لكل شخص أن يشارك في التبرع عن طريق الاتصال على الرقم المخصص لهذا الغرض، وبمجرد اتصاله على الرقم سيحسب من اتصاله 10 ريال تكون له ذخرا عند الله وجهاداً في سبيل تحرير القدس والمسجد الأقصى.
body_en:
As part of the 'Sent Wind' campaign of solidarity with our brothers in Jerusalem, sponsored by the Charitable Works Committee of the State of Bahrain, the 4Shbab channel hosted His Eminence the erudite scholar Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew and His Eminence Shaykh Raed Salah, the Shaykh of al-Aqsa.

The 4Shbab channel broadcast this interview on the evening of today, Wednesday 15 Ramadan 1434 AH, corresponding to 24 June 2013

During this programme Sheikh al-Dedew reviewed the cause of Jerusalem in the al-Aqsa Mosque and its deep-rooted Islamic history, speaking of the historical origins of the city of Jerusalem (Aelia) and of the al-Aqsa Mosque, and reviewing in this the report of the Night Journey and the Ascension of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) and his rising to the heavens.

Sheikh al-Dedew called for the necessity of seizing this opportunity to support this charitable project for the cause of Jerusalem and the al-Aqsa Mosque with every effort; and he gave a considered legal opinion (fatwā) that responsibility for Jerusalem rests on the shoulders of all Muslims, the distant among them and the near alike. Every person can take part in donating by calling the number designated for this purpose; and as soon as he calls the number, 10 riyals will be counted from his call, which will be a store laid up for him with God and a jihad for the sake of the liberation of Jerusalem and the al-Aqsa Mosque.

flags.context: the broadcast date of the interview
options: read يونيو as a misprint for يوليو (July)
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). 15 Ramadan 1434 falls on 24 July 2013, and the CMS timestamp on this record is 24 July 2013; 'يونيو' is a misprint for 'يوليو'. The English reproduces the source's 'June' rather than silently correcting it, and the record's 'date' field uses the correct July date.

flags.arabic: وبمجرد اتصاله على الرقم سيحسب من اتصاله 10 ريال تكون له ذخرا عند الله وجهاداً في سبيل تحرير القدس
flags.context: the fundraising appeal at the close of the report
options: a store laid up for him with God and a jihad for the sake of the liberation of Jerusalem
a treasure with God and a struggle for the liberation of Jerusalem
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW. A premium-rate telephone donation is described as 'jihad for the liberation of Jerusalem'. The sentence is the reporter's, not the Sheikh's quoted words, but it sits immediately after his fatwā and reads in English as his endorsement of a fundraising mechanism whose proceeds are characterised in those terms. Rendered without softening; publication is a decision for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

flags.arabic: فضيلة الشيخ رائد صلاح شيخ الأقصى
options: His Eminence Shaykh Raed Salah, the Shaykh of al-Aqsa
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW. Raed Salah is a figure subject to legal restrictions and proscription proceedings in more than one jurisdiction. He is named faithfully and with the honorific the source gives him; the decision about publishing a page that presents him as a co-participant belongs to Ummah Collective, not the translator.

flags.context: واستعرض الشيخ الددو خلال هذا البرنامج قضية القدس في المسجد الأقصى
options: the cause of Jerusalem in the al-Aqsa Mosque (as the source has it)
the cause of Jerusalem and the al-Aqsa Mosque (reading في as a slip for و)
flags.note: The preposition makes the phrase incoherent — Jerusalem is not a cause located inside the mosque. The following clause pairs the two with a conjunction, which supports option 1. Rendered as the source has it and flagged.

translator_notes: Report of a televised fundraising appearance. '4Shbab' is the channel's own Latin branding. '(إيليا)' is Aelia Capitolina, the Roman name for Jerusalem, kept as the source gives it. 'حديث رحلة الإسراء والمعراج' is rendered 'the report of the Night Journey and the Ascension' — a body of narrative, not a single graded hadith, and no grading has been added. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
